detaileddescription.para:
Update point cloud from RGBD images. Converts depth + color images into a colored point cloud on the GPU using the depthToColoredPointCloud kernel.
depth_image
Device-resident depth image.
color_image
Device-resident color image.
depth_cam
Camera intrinsics for depth sensor.
color_cam
Camera intrinsics for color sensor.
stream
CUDA stream.
True if update was initiated, false if visualizer not initialized.
Internally synchronizes the stream to read back the point count.

Update mesh from nvblox ColorMesh.
mesh
Device-resident colored mesh with vertices, colors, and triangles. The triangles vector contains flat vertex indices where every 3 consecutive indices form one triangle. Triangle count is mesh.triangles.size() / 3.
stream
CUDA stream.
True if update was initiated, false if visualizer not initialized.
Data is copied asynchronously. Call stream.synchronize() before render() to ensure data transfer is complete.
If mesh.triangles.size() is not divisible by 3, a warning is logged and the remaining indices are ignored.

sect2.title: Error Handling
sect2.para: Init and render methods return false on failure and log via glog.

sect2.title: Thread Safety
sect2.para: Not thread-safe. All calls must be from the same thread.

sect2.title: Synchronization
sect2.para: Caller must call stream.synchronize() after CUDA updates and before render(). CPU sync is used for simplicity and portability; GPU-GPU sync via timeline semaphores is possible by modifying VkContext::endFrame().
